somaticsniper.label: SomaticSniper
somaticsniper.description: Calls somatic SNVs from tumour and normal BAMs. This archived upstream caller does not call indels.

somatic.label: Call somatic SNVs
somatic.description: The tumour BAM comes before the normal BAM.

help.label: Version
help.description: Show the upstream version. Run with an empty argument array for the full usage message (which exits with status 1).

lofreq.label: LoFreq
lofreq.description: Runs the upstream variant calculations in WebAssembly. The somatic workflow uses one processing thread; upstream labels it experimental.

somatic.label: Call somatic SNVs
somatic.description: Compare the tumour with its matched normal. LoFreq describes its somatic workflow as experimental.

tumor-indelqual.label: Add tumour indel qualities
tumor-indelqual.description: Prepare a separate BAM for indel calling; the original BAM is retained.

normal-indelqual.label: Add normal indel qualities
normal-indelqual.description: Prepare the matched normal for indel calling.

tumor-index.label: Index the prepared tumour BAM
tumor-index.description: Run this after adding tumour indel qualities.

normal-index.label: Index the prepared normal BAM
normal-index.description: Run this after adding normal indel qualities.

somatic-indels.label: Call somatic SNVs and indels
somatic-indels.description: First run both indel-quality commands and both indexing commands above.

call.label: Call variants in the tumour
call.description: This single-sample command does not distinguish somatic from germline variants.

hcc1395.label: Human tumour/normal (HCC1395 / HCC1395BL)
hcc1395.description: Real matched tumour and normal reads from two small regions. Reference and alignment coordinates are rebased together; original genome coordinates and selection are recorded in the data documentation.
